rules.rationale: Explicit news, update, blog and announcement paths contain current public reporting.
Explicit research, publication, project and scholarly-output paths describe research activity.
Explicit event, career, application, admission, funding, award and volunteer paths invite participation.
Explicit people, alumni, story, profile and memorial paths center personal accounts.
Explicit contact, resource, service, safety, policy, form and student-support paths provide practical guidance.
